steward_ingra.name: Ingra, Steward of Saltfell
lines_first: Late for the feast, traveller? The fires are high and the mead is cold, the way it should be.
This is Saltfell Steading. Tonight is the last long evening of summer — the shearing starts at first light.
If you sit by the hearthstone, mind it: they say it remembers. Sit long enough and it will show you what it remembers now.
lines_repeat: Eat something. Winter is a long way off yet.
The headman is in the long hall, counting the stores again.

services.label: Trade for a Deep Gourd — 300 warmth
Learn the Mending Song — 200 warmth
services.line_done: Hum it low. It works better when nobody is listening.
